semiconductor_relevance: High — JTA Ltd. specializes in equipment for semiconductor manufacturing processes, particularly in wafer handling and lamination.
summary: JTA Ltd. provides advanced equipment for semiconductor manufacturers, focusing on Takatori systems for wafer vacuum taping, lamination, and temporary bonding. They also supply wafer sorters and measurement tools, catering to the needs of wafer manufacturers and MEMS device production.
capabilities: Takatori vacuum taping and detaping systems
LED production taping and mounting systems
